description: Replaces a text project's word rules. Each rule has a term (whole word, case insensitive) and a mode: block (flag without checking), bypass (pass without checking), remove (strip the word before checking) or substitute (swap in replacement before checking). Returns the previous rules so they can be put back. Live within about 5 minutes. Up to 500 rules. Needs owner, admin or editor access.

word_rules.description: The full new set of rules. An empty list removes them all.

name: save_word_rules
title: Save a project's word rules
